nonClaims: No candidate, evaluation, review, provider call, human result, external result, held-out result, production result, selection, promotion, or release is produced.

occurrenceScoring.typeMismatch: one diagnostic correction; never changes occurrence or relation identity

propositionAbstention.full: only when zero safe propositions can be finalized
propositionAbstention.none: finalize all safe propositions and expose no unsafe finalization
propositionAbstention.partial: only when explicit unsafe proposition(s) coexist with at least one safe proposition
propositionAbstention.scope: abstention and quarantine are evaluated per proposition

relationGrounding.identity: predicate plus anchored source and target occurrence identities

decisionRules: Use the most specific noun-phrase and predicate context supported by the source.
Occurrence identity is anchored start/end/text and is independent of type.
If type remains tied, quarantine only that proposition; never guess or escalate to full abstention.
